description: This file defines a utility class Utils containing static methods for handling PSR-7 HTTP message components, including stream manipulation, request modification, and URI handling, used within the Guzzle HTTP client library.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A final class offering static utility methods for stream handling, request modification, URI handling, and other helper functions within the Guzzle PSR-7 implementation.

methods.name: caselessRemove
methods.description: Removes specified keys from data regardless of case, useful for header manipulation.

methods.name: copyToStream
methods.description: Copies data from a source stream to a destination stream up to a maximum length.

methods.name: copyToString
methods.description: Reads data from a stream into a string up to a maximum length.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Calculates a hash of a stream's contents using a specified algorithm.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Creates a modified clone of a request with provided changes, including headers, method, URI, body, and version.

methods.name: readLine
methods.description: Reads a line from the stream up to a maximum length.

methods.name: streamFor
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface object from various resource types, strings, or callables.

methods.name: tryFopen
methods.description: Attempts to open a file stream safely, throwing an exception on failure.

methods.name: uriFor
methods.description: Returns a UriInterface for a string or existing UriInterface; throws if invalid.
